protocol.selection: Five fixed pairs selected before fetching results: ETH hill/river crossing, dense old town, commercial corridor, treed lakeshore, northern district. This is a purposive diagnostic set, not a representative accuracy sample.
protocol.coordinateSource: Committed Zurich place data; Oerlikon junction coordinates from pavement-expansion-validation.json. Same requested endpoints are sent to both services; actual snapping is retained.
protocol.timeLimitation: The author's presentation specifies 1 August 2024 at 16:00; the public raster does not encode civil_time. Compare 16:00 CEST and the earlier independent SPA-derived 16:00 local-solar-time interpretation at the central pilot. No interpretation is asserted correct.

cases.setting: Treed lakeshore and open water edge

configuration: Public bundle.js: /routed-foot/route/v1, /routed-vampire/route/v1; default profile path driving is statically overridden by each extracted walking backend. Profile-selection UI uses 4.5 km/h (foot) and 4 km/h (vampire). Direct permalink initially displays raw API duration until profile selection; configuredWalkingMinutes is not asserted to be the observed UI value.
